article.headline: Johnson scores 23 as Denver defeats Kansas City 87-74
article.description: — Carson Johnson had 23 points in Denver's 87-74 win over Kansas City on Wednesday.
article.linkText: Johnson scores 23 as Denver defeats Kansas City 87-74
article.story: DENVER -- — Carson Johnson had 23 points in Denver's 87-74 win over Kansas City on Wednesday. Johnson shot 7 for 16 (2 for 5 from 3-point range) and 7 of 7 from the free-throw line for the Pioneers (8-8, 1-0 Summit League). Zane Nelson scored 17 points and added four steals. Jeremiah Burke had 16 points and shot 6 for 12, including 3 for 6 from beyond the arc. Karmello Branch finished with 18 points for the Roos (3-12, 0-1). Kansas City also got 17 points and eight assists from CJ Evans. Chris Dockery finished with 13 points and 11 rebounds. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
